our_interpretation: The checkable core is whether Microsoft's February 2024 Copilot advertisement materially misrepresented the results obtainable from the tasks it depicted.
The plain reading concerns usable results under the conditions represented in the advertisement. It does not require identical outputs on every attempt.
The target period is February 2024, the month of the advertisement, with the assessment restricted to product capabilities before the February 27 post.
Calling a result misleading and alleging deliberate lying are distinct. The latter requires evidence that the advertiser knowingly represented a false result.
Whether a description is compelling or resembles science fiction is subjective and cannot independently determine the outcome.
The advertising cost and company valuation identify the advertisement; they are not treated as separate financial propositions.
criteria.support_condition: The advertisement and contemporaneous tests or production records establish that its depicted results materially misrepresented the product's capabilities under the represented conditions. Establishing outright lying also requires evidence of knowing misrepresentation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous reproductions or authenticated production records establish that the depicted practical results were attainable under materially equivalent conditions, without undisclosed intervention that changes the advertised capability.

evidence.excerpt: Copilot adeptly cooked up some questions
evidence.locator: Chemistry quiz; related findings in Storyboarding scenarios, Coding context, and Logo looniness
evidence.explanation: The reporter reproduced the chemistry exercise, countering the suggestion that no practical advertised task worked, but also encountered garbled sign lettering and incomplete initial results elsewhere. Microsoft told the reporter that visible prompts were shortened; these firsthand journalistic tests establish neither the provenance of the advertised outputs nor deliberate deception.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Authenticated advertisement production records and complete prompt histories, compared with repeated tests of the contemporaneous product, could establish whether the results were materially misrepresented. Evidence of knowing fabrication would resolve the stronger allegation of lying.
